The main takeaway from our work is that
the LOS RV shift of broad lines is a useful tool to probe the presence of massive BBHs in the centers of quasars.
long-term spectroscopic observations can provide a powerful tool to identify sub-pc BB Hs in quasars, and to probe the orbital motion of the BB Hs.
